{{Quote|The Force is strong in my family. My father has it. I have it. And my sister has it.|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Episode VI" />}}
The '''Skywalker family''' or '''Skywalker clan''', was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] bloodline whose first known member was [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]]. The clan contributed members to both the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Old]]<ref name="TPM" /> and [[New Jedi Order]]s,<ref name="Jedi Search" /> as well as the ranks of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]].<ref name="ROTS" /> Through several generations, the Skywalker family remained extraordinarily prominent in galactic affairs, having a significant impact on major historical events for over 150 years.

==History==
{{Quote|Be a Skywalker?! ''That's'' turned out ''real'' well for our family, hasn't it? Killed my father – and look what it did to ''yours''!|Cade Skywalker, to Luke Skywalker's [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]]|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 3">[[Legacy (2006) 3|''Legacy'' (2006) 3]]</ref>}}
[[File:Betrayal.jpg|thumb|left|Around [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], members of the Skywalker family share dinner with members of the [[Solo family/Legends|House of Solo]] and [[Zekk]].|234x234px]]
[[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker's]] son, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], was conceived by the will of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> and raised on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TPM" />

As a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], Anakin [[Wedding of Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala/Legends|married]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="AOTC" /> [[19 BBY/Legends|Three years later]], Amidala gave birth to twins, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]], passing away soon after. Due to Anakin's fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and transformation to Darth Vader, Luke was raised on Tatooine by his uncle and aunt, [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen]] and [[Beru Whitesun Lars/Legends|Beru Lars]] (Anakin's step-brother and step-sister-in-law), while Leia was raised by [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail]] and [[Breha Organa/Legends|Breha Organa]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="ROTS" />

Leia [[Wedding of Han Solo and Leia Organa/Legends|married]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]<ref name="The Courtship of Princess Leia" /> and had three children: twins [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina]] and [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]],<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref> and a younger son [[Anakin Solo|Anakin]], who was named after his grandfather, in [[10 ABY/Legends|10.5 ABY]].<ref name="DE2">''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire II]]''</ref>

In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], Luke [[Wedding of Luke Skywalker and Mara Jade|married]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]].<ref name="Union" /> Their son, [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]], who was named after Luke's first mentor [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan "Ben" Kenobi]], was born in [[26 ABY/Legends|26.5 ABY]].<ref name="Edge of Victory">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]''</ref> Ben would later become the ancestor of brothers [[Rawk|Nat]] and [[Kol Skywalker]], as well as Kol's son [[Cade Skywalker|Cade]]. Cade lived during [[130 ABY]] and was the last surviving Skywalker of his time,<ref name="Broken">''[[Star Wars: Legacy: Broken]]''</ref> his uncle having abandoned the famous name and living as "Bantha" Rawk. Nat married the [[Kiffar/Legends|Kiffar]] healer [[Droo Rawk]] of [[Clan Vos]] and adopted her biological daughter, [[Ahnah Rawk|Ahnah]], and two other children [[Skeeto Rawk|Skeeto]] and [[Micah (Cathar)|Micah]].

The droids [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] were both the creation or property of Anakin and Padmé respectively.<ref name="TPM" /><ref name="AOTC" /> Eventually the droids would later fall into the hands of their children. R2-D2 went under the possession of Luke Skywalker<ref name="ANH" /> whereas C-3PO mostly remained with Leia Organa Solo and her family.<ref name="HTTE" />

The family was unaware that they were related to the [[Naberrie family/Legends|Naberrie family]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] until [[36 ABY]], when Luke discovered a group of holograms within R2-D2 dealing with the final days of his mother's life.<ref name="DN1">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref> Soon after, Leia traveled to Naboo to meet with [[Pooja Naberrie/Legends|Pooja Naberrie]] and revealed their relationship.<ref name="JvsS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>

==The dark side==
{{Quote|She has the Skywalker anger&hellip;like her brother&hellip;like her father.|[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], in reference to Leia Organa Solo|<ref name="Dark Empire 5">[[Dark Empire 5|''Dark Empire'' 5]]</ref>}}
Since the conception of Anakin Skywalker, the majority of the Skywalker family fell to or struggled with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. Anakin, whose very existence was [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|influenced by]] the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]],<ref name="DP" /> became Darth Vader, one of the most feared Sith Lords in history.<ref name="ROTS" /> His son Luke eventually took his father's place as the Emperor's apprentice as a hoax for a short while.<ref name="DE" /> Luke's sister Leia had three children. Her youngest son Anakin died at an early age,<ref name="SBS">''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]''</ref> sending his sister Jaina nearly over to the dark side, before she came back from the edge of darkness.<ref name="DJ">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Journey]]''</ref> Leia's oldest son, Jacen, became [[Darth Caedus]]; unlike the other Skywalkers, Caedus did not want to be redeemed, having been led to believe that he could be a Sith and not be evil, only to end up doing "wrong things for the right reasons." Luke married a former [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] Mara Jade, and their son Ben was influenced by his cousin Jacen/Caedus to commit an [[Dur Gejjen|assassination]] and other questionable acts.<ref name="Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref> Even 130 years after the rise of Luke Skywalker, his descendant, Cade Skywalker, was still dealing with his family's attraction to the dark side. Cade became an apprentice to [[Darth Talon]] in service to [[Darth Krayt]], the new [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]. However, he abandoned this position and escaped Krayt's grasp with the help of his friends.<ref name="COTD">''[[Star Wars: Legacy: Claws of the Dragon]]''</ref>

Perhaps the most fascinating thing about the Skywalker family was not how easily they tended to fall to the dark side, but how they eventually returned to the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]]. All known members of the Skywalker clan except Caedus who fell to the dark side returned to the light and redeemed themselves. Even Darth Caedus forsook vengeance against his killer a moment before his death to save his lover and daughter,<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref> though his ghost was more or less unrepentant, however he admitted he probably deserved what happened to him.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref> In the long history of the Jedi, this was known as a very uncommon feat. Usually their redemption relied on the support and determination of their family members and close friends. The belief in redemption, originating with Padmé Amidala,<ref name="ROTS" /> and continued on by Luke Skywalker, was a powerful weapon the Skywalkers used to battle the dark side from within and without.

==Behind the scenes==
Several roads and locations in the real world were influenced by ''[[Star Wars]]'' culture and named after the famous Skywalkers, most notably the [[Skywalker Drive]]s.

In the canceled novel ''[[Alien Exodus]]'', the main character Cosmo Hender gets the ability to tap into the Force through a giant crystal, giving him telekinetic powers and the ability to levitate, causing the other slaves to nickname him "Skywalker" because of his powers. This would have originated the founder of the Skywalker family.
